C-71-TABLE-CENTER.Name: Center expanded long-cell tables in the editor viewport
C-71-TABLE-CENTER.Summary: Reproduce the owner's remaining C-71 centering report in Mark Test with long cells and the outline visible, identify the geometry error, and deliver a separately protected fix with regression evidence and CI.
C-71-TABLE-CENTER.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved the proposed four-step follow-up on 2026-10-19: table geometry first, outline interaction separately, one fresh acceptance build, then unversioned release preparation.

Goals.Goal: Center a natural-width expanded table that fits the full owning editor client viewport, even when it intersects the independently overlaid outline.
Keep genuinely oversized tables reachable from the left gutter through editor horizontal scrolling.

Constraints.Constraint: Preserve Markdown, history, saved state and persisted column widths. Keep the 2px browser threshold and 24px overflow gutter.
Do not move the text column or outline, change outline interaction in this commit, bump versions, tag or publish.
Use the common safety hooks for each commit/push and preserve unrelated working trees.

NonGoals.NonGoal: The intersecting outline region's hover behavior is a separate change after this geometry repair.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Long-cell and moderate-width tables center in Chromium and WebKit with the outline visible/hidden and through sidebar/window/font changes. Tables wider than the viewport retain reachable overflow.
Unit/browser checks, GRACE checks and integrated CI pass; native reproduction and exact build identity are recorded separately from owner acceptance.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-012 tableResize geometry and table regression suites; graph and verification projections.
